sources.label: Ochiai & Goshima — gamete differentiation in Bryopsis (2026)

research.summary: Bright clay forms seem caught between gestures and identities. In Bryopsis, reducing the female-specific regulator BrRWP1 shifted gamete size and several other traits toward male-like characteristics, yet did not fully masculinize the gametes and caused fertilization defects. Inspired by a primary study published online in Current Biology on 4 November 2026.

title: A Small Riot · 小小的骚动
